articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: How Steve Cahillane’s Arrival and Planned Breakup At Kraft Heinz (KHC) Has Changed Its Investment Story. In early January 2026, Steve Cahillane took over as CEO of Kraft Heinz, prompting fresh attention on the company’s previously announced plan to split into two businesses later this year. An interesting twist is that investors are now questioning whether Cahillane, who has a history of unlocking value by breaking up companies, will endorse or rethink this separation.
